How to play

Steer your yellow submarine over every gold star. Rest your thumb on the teal knob and nudge it to steer. You can also tap the outer ring. Aim just before a corner to turn as soon as it opens. Lift your thumb to keep sailing, or pull back to reverse. You can also swipe the maze or use the arrow keys.

Riptail copies your trail a few seconds behind you, even through tunnels. Watch your wake when you turn back!

A mint glow pearl gives you six seconds to chase the sea creatures. Tap Glow boost or press Space for one extra burst per maze.

Swim through a side tunnel to pop out on the other side. When three stars are left, they ripple on the map.
